newsitem.title: FINLAND: K-S MEDIA OFFERS FIM 67 FOR S.SANOMAT SHRS.
newsitem.headline: K-S MEDIA OFFERS FIM 67 FOR S.SANOMAT SHRS.

text.p: Media group Keski-Suomen Media Oy said in a statement on Friday it offered to redeem outstanding shares in publishing house Savon Sanomat Oy for 67.00 markka per share.
The redemption period would start on May 7, and the redemption price would be 67.00 markka per share until Savon Sanomat's annual general meeting on May 13.

On condition that Savon Sanomat shareholders approve the board's proposed 3.00 markka per share dividend, the redemption price would be 64.00 markka per share from May 14, Keski-Suomen media said. The redemption period would end on June 9.
Currently Keski-Suomen Media has 74.09 percent of shares and votes in Savon Sanomat.
Savon Sanomat's market value at end-1996 was 85.9 million markka, the company's annual report said.
On April 29, Savon Sanomat's share closed at 68.00 markka.
